entities.name: Acetyl-CoA carboxylase beta subunit
observations: The 314-aa query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to UniProt Q2JIG8 from Synechococcus sp. JA-2-3B'a(2-13).
The protein is the carboxyl-transferase beta subunit of acetyl-CoA carboxylase (ACC), which transfers CO2 from carboxylated biotin to acetyl-CoA to form malonyl-CoA.
Curated annotations place it in the cytoplasm and associate it with zinc ion binding, acetyl-CoA carboxylase activity, and carboxyl- or carbamoyltransferase activity.
It participates in malonyl-CoA biosynthesis and fatty-acid biosynthesis as part of the ACC complex.

entities.name: Acetyl-CoA to malonyl-CoA
observations: In ACC, the carboxyl-transferase subunit transfers CO2 from biotin carboxyl carrier protein to acetyl-CoA, producing malonyl-CoA.

entities.name: Malonyl-CoA biosynthesis
observations: The protein is part of the acetyl-CoA-to-malonyl-CoA step in lipid metabolism.

entities.name: Fatty acid biosynthesis
observations: The ACC beta subunit contributes to fatty-acid biosynthesis by enabling malonyl-CoA formation.
